input: Prepare me for a meeting with Attio (attio.com)

what_they_do.value: Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue: a platform that builds pipeline, advances deals, and grows accounts around the clock.

priorities.priority: Build and ship an AI-native CRM platform with programmable AI primitives, agent collaboration, natural-language workflows, and an extensible app ecosystem.
priorities.evidence: Attio says it is investing in APIs, SDKs, natural-language interfaces, an App SDK in beta, agent collaboration, and advanced permissions; it describes engineering as a focus area with continued team scaling and heavy R&D investment.
priorities.date: 2025-08 (Series B announcement; exact publication date not shown on opened page)

priorities.priority: Expand globally and scale go-to-market around the company’s ‘GTM builder’ customer segment.
priorities.evidence: The Series B announcement says Attio will keep expanding globally to GTM builders everywhere and reports 5,000 paying customers with a goal of 4x ARR growth that year.
priorities.date: 2025-08 (Series B announcement; exact publication date not shown on opened page)

priorities.priority: Make CRM context conversational and actionable through Ask Attio and AI agents.
priorities.evidence: Attio launched Ask Attio so users can query records, calls, emails, web searches, and connected data sources through AI; the product is positioned for meeting preparation, customer-success handoffs, and surfacing expansion or risk signals.
priorities.date: 2026-02-04 (date reported in an opened 2026 product review)

priorities.priority: Automate revenue operations and outbound execution with Workflows and revenue agents.
priorities.evidence: Attio describes workflows that research leads, score them against an ICP, create deals, assign AEs, detect funding/executive/hiring signals, and let teams build workflows in natural language.
priorities.date: 2026-06-09 (date reported in an opened 2026 product review)

priorities.priority: Scale the team through builder-oriented hiring, including GTM Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Partnerships graduates.
priorities.evidence: Attio calls its graduate program a core talent philosophy, says graduates have pushed new AI-supercharged ways of working, and lists hiring in GTM Engineering, Customer Success & Support, and Partnerships.
priorities.date: 2026 (page does not show a more specific publication date)

challenges.challenge: Credit-based billing can make AI, enrichment, and workflow costs less predictable at scale.
challenges.evidence: An independent 2026 review says Attio combines seat pricing with usage-based credits and that reviewers flag credit usage as something that needs watching, especially for enrichment and agents across large record sets.

challenges.challenge: Native integrations and the broader integration ecosystem remain less extensive than larger CRM competitors.
challenges.evidence: The 2026 review says the native library is still thin compared with HubSpot and Salesforce and that reviewers flag missing native integrations, particularly for email marketing, sometimes requiring Zapier.

challenges.challenge: Reporting and sales-activity analytics are not yet as deep as incumbent CRM platforms.
challenges.evidence: The review reports complaints that built-in reporting is generic, that users export raw data to Google Sheets, and that per-rep activity reporting requires workarounds.

challenges.challenge: Support, onboarding, SLAs, and governance become constraints for larger or more operationally demanding teams.
challenges.evidence: The review says lower tiers lack live chat and an SLA below Enterprise, onboarding materials are thin for advanced automations, and credit caps and missing integrations become operational constraints as teams grow beyond roughly 10–15 people.

recent_changes.headline: Activities: capture support tickets, social DMs, and product events as structured data
recent_changes.summary: Attio added Activities so teams can bring interactions into records with custom schemas, use them in Workflows, log them from Zapier, and report on them.

recent_changes.headline: Workflows updates extend team messaging and workflow variables
recent_changes.summary: Workflow Send actions can message a person or channel in Slack, the variable picker is searchable, and Broadcast/Celebration blocks can address teams as well as individuals.

recent_changes.headline: How Attio uses Attio to run its GTM
recent_changes.summary: Attio described a close-to-200-person, product-led Series B company using one shared context layer for signups, leads, support tickets, product usage, sales, and customer-success signals; the page names Kyle Doherty and Zev Lebowitz as operators behind the system.

key_people.name: Nicolas Sharp
key_people.title: CEO and co-founder
key_people.recent: In a March 2026 GV interview, Sharp said Attio’s differentiation is an AI CRM built to ingest and understand emails, calls, product data, billing, and calendar events in real time, while remaining flexible and connected to the rest of a company’s workflows.

key_people.name: Alex Christie
key_people.title: Co-founder
key_people.recent: The GV interview says Christie co-founded Attio with Sharp after assessing Salesforce’s API and user experience and concluding there was substantial room to improve CRM.

key_people.name: Michael McBride
key_people.title: GV General Partner and Attio board member
key_people.recent: Attio announced that McBride joined its board as part of the Series B; the company highlighted his experience scaling GitLab revenue more than 100x through IPO and beyond.

key_people.name: Kyle Doherty
key_people.title: Rev Ops Lead
key_people.recent: Doherty is named as one of the operators explaining how Attio centralizes leads, customer interactions, and communication in Attio and its wider GTM stack.

key_people.name: Zev Lebowitz
key_people.title: Head of Solutions
key_people.recent: Lebowitz is named alongside Doherty as an operator behind Attio’s shared GTM context layer and customer operating model.

talking_points: As Attio scales AI agents and usage-based credits, how are you balancing agent autonomy with predictable cost, governance, and permissions?
With Activities and Workflows now pulling more support, product, and engagement signals into the CRM, which new signals most improve prioritization for Sales and Customer Success?
As Attio expands globally and beyond startup-sized teams, where are integration depth, reporting, onboarding, or SLA requirements creating the most friction?
